request.prompt: Animate ONLY the single reference fighter, facing RIGHT, fixed side-view camera. Crisp 16-bit pixel art, identical costume, silhouette, palette and proportions. Solid flat #ff00ff background throughout, no floor, no shadows, no camera motion, no opponent, no text. Keep the entire actor, longest extensions and all props at least 15% away from EVERY camera edge through the whole motion; do not zoom in. Animate in place; the game engine supplies world movement. Action: grab — this single fighter alone mimes a grab on empty air: reach out, close both hands on nothing, and hold the clench. NO second character, no opponent, no other body anywhere — only this one fighter. Interpret these six frame roles as six consecutive key moments of this video: ONLY this one fighter is in frame (no opponent, no second body): frames 1-2 = reach/lunge forward into empty air, frame 3 = hand extends forward toward nothing, frame 4 = hands clench shut on empty air (the grab mime, gripping an invisible target), frame 5 = pulling the clenched hands inward, frame 6 = holding the clench with both hands closed on nothing. CHARACTER BODY PASS ONLY: no explosions, muzzle flashes, impact bursts, detached projectiles or lingering trails. Those are separate runtime VFX/entities, not pixels baked into this body animation. Motion brief: A dockside prizefighter with too many arms and a strict no-hooks policy. The policy refers only to fishing equipment. Move: grab — this single fighter alone mimes a grab on empty air: reach out, close both hands on nothing, and hold the clench. NO second character, no opponent, no other body anywhere — only this one fighter. Side-view fighting game sprite row. Magenta background, full body visible, generous gutters, no cropping.
